Repo: /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa. Branch: feature/SFCC-91_pdp-colour-swatches. This is a REWORK round (round 2) on SFCC-91 Step 2. A prior round built `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmColourSwatch/` and got everything right except one wrong CSS variable name, confirmed by three independent methods (a registry read, a repo-wide grep, and a real-Chromium render proving the background renders fully transparent instead of ivory). The Scorer's instruction is narrow and exact — do ONLY this, nothing else. Do not stage, do not commit.

Make exactly these three single-line substitutions, changing `-background-02` to `-bg-02` in each:

1. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmColourSwatch/zimmColourSwatch.css.ts` line 31 — change `backgroundColor: 'var(--zimm-color-background-02)',` to `backgroundColor: 'var(--zimm-color-bg-02)',`

2. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmColourSwatch/index.test.tsx` line 112 — change `expect(getComputedStyle(swatch).backgroundColor).toBe('var(--zimm-color-background-02)');` to `expect(getComputedStyle(swatch).backgroundColor).toBe('var(--zimm-color-bg-02)');`

3. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmColourSwatch/index.test.tsx` line 31 — this is inside a file-level comment block, quoting the wrong value as an illustrative example (`` `"var(--zimm-color-background-02)"` ``). Update it to `` `"var(--zimm-color-bg-02)"` `` so the comment doesn't assert something false.

Do NOT touch anything else in either file. Do NOT touch `index.tsx` or `index.stories.tsx` — they were confirmed clean. Do NOT re-examine or change the border/focus-ring logic, the `parts` array, the `href`-branching, or the deliberate omission of a name-derived background colour — all independently confirmed correct in the prior review round; re-litigating any of it is scope creep this rework round doesn't need.

Line numbers are approximate (based on the file's state before this rework) — find each string by content if the exact line number is off by one or two, don't assume it's precisely there without checking.

After making the three edits, run and report exact output:
```
npx tsc --noEmit
npx vitest run overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmColourSwatch/index.test.tsx
npm run test
node scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs
grep -rn "zimm-color-background" overrides/
```

Expected results: `tsc` 0 errors. The scoped vitest run should show all 8 tests in that file passing, and specifically the regression-guard test ("does not set a raw CSS-colour-keyword backgroundColor...") should now be passing against a REAL resolved value rather than a vacuous echo — if you want to double check this is a meaningful assertion now rather than trust it, you can temporarily verify `getComputedStyle` in this test environment still doesn't resolve `var()` to a hex (it echoes the literal declaration text, confirmed in the prior round) — if so, the test is now asserting the literal now-correct string `'var(--zimm-color-bg-02)'`, which is the right token, so the test is meaningful again (it will fail if someone reverts to the wrong name or a different value, exactly as designed). `npm run test` should be back to 27 files / 417 tests, same as the pre-rework baseline, all passing (no test was added or removed, only a string literal fixed). `audit:tokens` should be unchanged: 4 unacknowledged / 22 acknowledged. The final grep should return ZERO hits anywhere in `overrides/` — confirming the wrong name is completely gone, including from the comment.

Report back: full output of every command, and confirmation that `git diff --stat` shows only these two files changed with a small number of line changes (this should be a tiny diff — 3 one-line substitutions).

1	import type { SystemStyleObject } from '@chakra-ui/react';
2	
3	/**
4	 * Recipe for a single PDP colour swatch — a clickable rectangle filled with that colour
5	 * variation's product photo. Two parts: `swatch` is the outer clickable box (geometry,
6	 * background, border, focus ring); `image` is the element carrying the dynamic
7	 * background-image fill — the URL itself cannot live here, see the component's own comment on
8	 * why that one `__css` spread stays dynamic.
9	 *
10	 * Values below are read directly off Figma for the three states this recipe distinguishes, not
11	 * estimated from surrounding metadata — Unselected (node 40000307:13826), Selected
12	 * (40000307:13831), Focus (40002689:3839), all under `size=Large/Rectangle`.
13	 */
14	export const ZimmColourSwatch = {
15	  parts: ['swatch', 'image'],
16	
17	  baseStyle: ({ selected }: { selected?: boolean }): Record<string, SystemStyleObject> => ({
18	    swatch: {
19	      display: 'inline-block',
20	      cursor: 'pointer',
21	      // Figma's Rectangle width (48px). Height (72px) has no direct token — the named scale has
22	      // nothing between 64px and 140px — so it's expressed as an aspect ratio on the width
23	      // instead. 2:3, not the incidentally different ratio Figma's raw code-gen attached to the
24	      // placeholder product photo pasted into that frame instance: the Selected-state node
25	      // carries its own dev annotation reading "Image aspect ratio - 2:3", which is the number
26	      // to trust here.
27	      width: 'var(--zimm-scale-1200)',
28	      aspectRatio: '2 / 3',
29	      // Identical across Unselected/Selected/Focus — ivory[200] / background['02'] in
30	      // theme/foundation/colour.ts.
31	      backgroundColor: 'var(--zimm-color-background-02)',
32	      // Selected: a bottom-only border — the raw Figma export is unambiguous, a `border-b`
33	      // utility rather than a full box border. Colour is grey[900] / border.focus, the only
34	      // alias-tier value that resolves to it (border.default and border.secondary are both
35	      // light greys and never appear anywhere in this design).
36	      ...(selected
37	        ? {
38	            borderBottomWidth: 'var(--zimm-border-width-default)',
39	            borderBottomStyle: 'solid',
40	            borderBottomColor: 'var(--zimm-color-border-focus)',
41	          }
42	        : {}),
43	      // Focus: Figma draws this as the Selected baseline plus a ring at slightly asymmetric
44	      // per-side offsets, same colour. Not replicated literally — there is no other precedent
45	      // anywhere in this codebase for a non-uniform ring, and the asymmetry reads as that one
46	      // frame instance's export noise rather than a deliberate design decision. Mirrors
47	      // zimmNavItem.css.ts's own focus-ring block instead: a uniform `outline` + `outlineOffset`
48	      // pair, applied independently of `selected` above — a swatch can be focused without being
49	      // selected, and selected without being focused. `--zimm-focus-ring` already composites the
50	      // same border-width/colour pair used above; `--zimm-focus-ring-offset-default` matches
51	      // three of Figma's four side offsets.
52	      _focusVisible: {
53	        outline: 'var(--zimm-focus-ring)',
54	        outlineOffset: 'var(--zimm-focus-ring-offset-default)',
55	      },
56	    },
57	    image: {
58	      display: 'block',
59	      width: '100%',
60	      height: '100%',
61	      backgroundSize: 'cover',
62	      backgroundPosition: 'center',
63	      backgroundRepeat: 'no-repeat',
64	    },
65	  }),
66	};
67
